card.name: End of a long subject before would/may
card.fires_on: The last word of a long noun phrase or gerund subject, right where the main verb comes next, usually a modal such as may, will, might or would. Mostly in science news and research abstracts.

card.writes: It promotes modal verbs such as would and could, so the next word is likely a hedging modal.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a long opening phrase, when a hedged verb like 'would' or 'may' is about to follow.
